cues.zh: >> 酒店职员：凯恩斯勋爵！欢迎您，先生。很荣幸。
cues.en: >> HOTEL CLERK: Lord Keynes! Welcome, sir. It's a pleasure.

cues.zh: >>凯恩斯：荣幸的是我才对。>>职员：您的日程——
cues.en: >>KEYNES: The pleasure's all mine. >>CLERK: Your agenda--

cues.zh: >>凯恩斯：那没必要。我就是日程。>>职员：[笑]
cues.en: >>KEYNES: That won't be necessary. I am the agenda. >>CLERK: [laughs]

cues.zh: >>凯恩斯：告诉他们我到了——>>哈耶克：然后告诉他们我到了。
cues.en: >>KEYNES: Tell them I've arrived-- >>HAYEK: And then tell them I've arrived.

cues.zh: >>职员：那么，您的名字是？
cues.en: >>CLERK: And, your name is?

cues.zh: >>哈耶克：哈耶克。F.A. 哈耶克。带个"H"。
cues.en: >>HAYEK: Hayek. F.A. Hayek. With an "H".

cues.zh: >>凯恩斯：弗雷迪。凯恩斯。嘿，听着，美联储有派对。
cues.en: >>KEYNES: Freddy. (yeah) Keynes. Hey, listen, party at the Fed.

cues.zh: >>哈耶克：已经？>>凯恩斯：二十分钟后。大堂见。
cues.en: >>HAYEK: Already? >>KEYNES: Twenty minutes. Lobby.

cues.zh: 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯。F.A. 哈耶克。
cues.en: John Maynard Keynes. F.A. Hayek.

cues.zh: >>凯恩斯：是啊，我们是对立的 >>哈耶克：我们在哲学上互相对立
cues.en: >>KEYNES: Yeah, we're opposed >>HAYEK: We oppose each other philosophically

cues.zh: >>凯恩斯：在同一个录音室里
cues.en: >>KEYNES: In the same studio

cues.zh: 我们这样来回争论了一个世纪
cues.en: We've been going back and forth for a century

cues.zh: >>凯恩斯：我想引导市场
cues.en: >>KEYNES: I want to steer markets

cues.zh: >>哈耶克：我想让市场自由
cues.en: >>HAYEK: I want them set free

cues.zh: 存在繁荣与萧条的周期，有充分理由为此恐惧
cues.en: There's a boom and bust cycle, and good reason to fear it

cues.zh: >>哈耶克：怪低利率 >>凯恩斯：不……是动物精神
cues.en: >>HAYEK: Blame low interest rates >>KEYNES: No... it's the animal spirits

cues.zh: 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯写了现代宏观经济学教科书，经济跑偏时你需要的那个人
cues.en: John Maynard Keynes wrote the book on modern macro The man you need when the economy's off track

cues.zh: 大萧条、衰退，现在你的问题开审了
cues.en: Depression, recession, Now your question's in session

cues.zh: 坐下吧，我用一堂简单的课教教你
cues.en: Have a seat and I'll school you in one simple lesson

cues.zh: 砰！1929年：大崩盘，我们没能反弹，经济进了垃圾堆
cues.en: Boom! 1929: the big crash, We didn't bounce back, economy's in the trash

cues.zh: 持续失业，是粘性工资的结果，等复苏？（认真的？）太离谱了
cues.en: Persistent unemployment, the result of sticky wages, Waiting for recovery? (Seriously?) That's outrageous

cues.zh: 我有个任何傻瓜都能懂的计划，建议很简单：提振总需求！
cues.en: I had a real plan any fool can understand, The advice real simple: boost aggregate demand!

cues.zh: C、I、G，加起来就是Y，让这个总量不断增长，看经济起飞
cues.en: C, I, G, altogether gets to Y, Keep that total growing, watch the economy fly

cues.zh: 我们已经争论了一个世纪
cues.en: We've been going back and forth for a century

cues.zh: >>凯恩斯：我想引导市场
cues.en: >>KEYNES: I want to steer markets

cues.zh: >>哈耶克：我想让市场自由
cues.en: >>HAYEK: I want them set free

cues.zh: 有繁荣与萧条的周期，有充分的理由为此担忧。
cues.en: There's a boom and bust cycle, and good reason to fear it.

cues.zh: >>哈耶克：怪低利率 >>凯恩斯：不……是动物精神
cues.en: >>HAYEK: Blame low interest rates >>KEYNES: No... it's the animal spirits

cues.zh: 你看，一切都关乎支出，听收银机叮当响
cues.en: You see it's all about spending, Hear the register cha-ching

cues.zh: 循环流动，钱就是一切
cues.en: Circular flow, The dough is everything

cues.zh: 所以如果这个流动变低，原因并不重要
cues.en: So if that flow is getting low, It doesn't matter the reason

cues.zh: 我们需要更多政府支出，现在是刺激季
cues.en: We need more government spending, Now it's stimulus season

cues.zh: 所以忘掉储蓄，把它从脑子里彻底抛开
cues.en: So forget about saving, Get it straight out of your head

cues.zh: 就像我说的，“从长远看，我们都死了”
cues.en: Like I said, "In the long run, we're all dead"

cues.zh: 储蓄就是毁灭，这就是节俭悖论，别把钱留在口袋里，否则增长永远起不来，因为
cues.en: Savings is destruction, that's the paradox of thrift, Don't keep money in your pocket or that growth will never lift, because

cues.zh: 商业由动物精神驱动，牛市和熊市，还有理由恐惧
cues.en: Business is driven by the animal spirits, The bull and the bear and there's reasons to fear

cues.zh: 它对资本投资、收入和增长的影响，这就是为什么国家应该填补缺口，用双重刺激
cues.en: It's effects on capital investment, income, and growth That's why the state should fill the gap, with stimulus both

cues.zh: 货币政策和财政政策，它们同样正确，公共工程、挖沟、战争都有同样的效果
cues.en: The monetary and the fiscal, they're equally correct Public works, digging ditches, war has the same effect

cues.zh: 甚至一扇破窗也能让玻璃匠有些财富，乘数效应推动经济健康上升
cues.en: Even a broken window helps the glass man have some wealth The multiplier driving higher the economy’s health

cues.zh: 而如果央行的利率政策失灵，陷入流动性陷阱，那新钱就卡在银行里了！
cues.en: And if the Central Bank’s interest rate policy tanks A liquidity trap, that new money’s stuck in the banks!

cues.zh: 赤字或许正是你一直在寻找的解药，既然知道了规则，就让支出飙升吧
cues.en: Deficits could be the cure, you been looking for Let the spending soar, now that you know the score

cues.zh: 我的《通论》影响深远[一场革命]，我改变了经济学界
cues.en: My General Theory’s made quite an impression [a revolution] I transformed the econ profession

cues.zh: 你了解我，一向谦虚，但我还是要鞠个躬，大声说出来，骄傲地说出来，我们现在都是凯恩斯主义者了
cues.en: You know me, modesty, still I’m taking a bow Say it loud, say it proud, we’re all Keynesians now

cues.zh: 我们已经来回争论了一个世纪
cues.en: We’ve been goin’ back and forth for a century

cues.zh: >>凯恩斯：我想引导市场，
cues.en: >>KEYNES: I want to steer markets,

cues.zh: >>哈耶克：我想让市场自由
cues.en: >>HAYEK: I want them set free

cues.zh: 存在繁荣与萧条的周期，有充分的理由恐惧它
cues.en: There’s a boom and bust cycle and good reason to fear it

cues.zh: >>凯恩斯：我已经陈述了我的观点，弗雷迪·H，听好了，你能听到吗？
cues.en: >>KEYNES: I made my case, Freddie H Listen up , Can you hear it?

cues.zh: >>哈耶克：我先从宏观层面讲起，就像我的朋友凯恩斯一样，他的理论掩盖了变革的机制
cues.en: >>HAYEK: I’ll begin in broad strokes, just like my friend Keynes His theory conceals the mechanics of change

cues.zh: 那个简单的方程式，过度aggregation，忽视了人的行为和动机
cues.en: That simple equation, too much aggregation Ignores human action and motivation

cues.zh: 然而它却继续作为正当理由，为政客们的救助和利益输送提供依据
cues.en: And yet it continues as a justification For bailouts and payoffs by pols with machinations

cues.zh: 你为他们提供掩护，让我们以为有免费午餐，最后剩下的只有债务和一堆
cues.en: You provide them with cover to sell us a free lunch Then all that we’re left with is debt, and a bunch

cues.zh: 如果你正靠着廉价信贷过着高消费的生活，别指望用“以毒攻毒”的方式来治病
cues.en: If you’re living high on that cheap credit hog Don’t look for cure from the hair of the dog

cues.zh: 如果你想投资，真实储蓄必须先行，市场用利率来协调时间
cues.en: Real savings come first if you want to invest The market coordinates time with interest

cues.zh: 你专注于支出，就像在推一根线，从长远来看，我的朋友，你的理论才是死路一条
cues.en: Your focus on spending is pushing on thread In the long run, my friend, it’s your theory that’s dead

cues.zh: 不好意思啊，朋友，如果这听起来像人身攻击，准备好接受我的奥地利学派视角的教育吧
cues.en: So sorry there, buddy, if that sounds like invective Prepare to get schooled in my Austrian perspective

cues.zh: 我们已经来回争论了一个世纪
cues.en: We’ve been going back and forth for a century

cues.zh: >>凯恩斯：我想驾驭市场，>>哈耶克：我想让市场自由
cues.en: >>KEYNES: I want to steer markets, >>HAYEK: I want them set free

cues.zh: 有繁荣与萧条的周期，有充分理由对此恐惧
cues.en: There’s a boom and bust cycle and good reason to fear it

cues.zh: >>哈耶克：怪低利率。>>凯恩斯：不……是动物精神
cues.en: >>HAYEK: Blame low interest rates. >>KEYNES: No… it’s the animal spirits

cues.zh: 你该研究的地方不是萧条，而是繁荣，那才该让你警惕，这正是
cues.en: The place you should study isn’t the bust It’s the boom that should make you feel leery, that’s the thrust

cues.zh: 我理论的核心：资本结构是关键。错误投资会摧毁经济
cues.en: Of my theory, the capital structure is key. Malinvestments wreck the economy

cues.zh: 繁荣始于信贷扩张，美联储压低利率，你开始明白了吗？
cues.en: The boom gets started with an expansion of credit The Fed sets rates low, are you starting to get it?

cues.zh: 那笔新钱被误当成真正可贷资金，但只是通胀在驱动那些
cues.en: That new money is confused for real loanable funds But it’s just inflation that’s driving the ones

cues.zh: 投资新项目的人，比如住房建设，繁荣为其未来的毁灭埋下种子
cues.en: Who invest in new projects like housing construction The boom plants the seeds for its future destruction

cues.zh: 储蓄并不真实，消费也在上升，对资源的争夺暴露出资源太少
cues.en: The savings aren’t real, consumption’s up too And the grasping for resources reveals there’s too few

cues.zh: 于是随着利率上升，繁荣转为萧条，生产成本方面，价格信号曾是谎言
cues.en: So the boom turns to bust as the interest rates rise With the costs of production, price signals were lies

cues.zh: 繁荣是一场狂欢，这是事实，如今是贬值后的资本在填补空缺。
cues.en: The boom was a binge that’s a matter of fact Now its devalued capital that makes up the slack.

cues.zh: 不管是二十年代末还是二〇〇五年，投资过热出问题，似乎都躲不过
cues.en: Whether it’s the late twenties or two thousand and five Booming bad investments, seems like they’d thrive

cues.zh: 你得储蓄才能投资，别靠印钞机，否则崩盘必至，经济萧条
cues.en: You must save to invest, don’t use the printing press Or a bust will surely follow, an economy depressed

cues.zh: 你那所谓的“刺激”只会让情况更糟，不过是老一套，激励越发扭曲
cues.en: Your so-called “stimulus” will make things even worse It’s just more of the same, more incentives perversed

cues.zh: 而且那信贷紧缩不是什么流动性陷阱，只是银行系统破产了，我说完了，收工。
cues.en: And that credit crunch ain’t a liquidity trap Just a broke banking system, I’m done, that’s a wrap.

cues.zh: 我们已经来回争论了一个世纪
cues.en: We’ve been goin’ back and forth for a century

cues.zh: >>凯恩斯：我想驾驭市场，>>哈耶克：我想让市场自由
cues.en: >>KEYNES: I want to steer markets, >>HAYEK: I want them set free

cues.zh: 存在繁荣与萧条的周期，有充分理由畏惧它
cues.en: There’s a boom and bust cycle and good reason to fear it

cues.zh: >>哈耶克：怪低利率。>>凯恩斯：不，是动物精神
cues.en: >>HAYEK: Blame low interest rates. >>KEYNES: No it’s the animal spirits
